description: The two fictional 2026 plan designs of the commercial employer-plan EOB: a self-funded, non-grandfathered ERISA plan with a PPO design and an HSA-qualified high-deductible design. Every number is fictional and sits within the limit stored beside it; each limit carries its citation and the date it was read. Amounts are dollars per plan year (calendar 2026).

acaOutOfPocket.rule: the 2026 maximum annual limitation on cost sharing; the self-only amount applies to each person, family coverage included
citations: PHS Act 2707(b), applied to self-funded group health plans (DOL ACA FAQs Part XXVII)
2025 Marketplace Integrity and Affordability final rule (published June 25, 2025)

hdhp.rule: an HSA-qualified plan's deductible is at least the minimum (under family coverage each person's embedded deductible too) and its out-of-pocket at most the maximum; no benefit before the deductible except preventive care

outOfNetworkCostSharing.rule: out-of-network cost sharing need not count toward the annual limitation, except for care the No Surprises Act protects
citations: reaching self-funded plans through DOL ACA FAQs Part XVIII Q4 and Part 60

essentialBenefits.rule: no annual or lifetime dollar limit on essential health benefits

nsaFacilities.rule: for non-emergency services, a health care facility is a hospital, a hospital outpatient department, a critical access hospital or an ambulatory surgical center; emergency care is protected wherever it is given
nsaFacilities.note: follows the definition of a health care facility for non-emergency services in 45 CFR 149.30

inNetwork.copayRules: office visits: the copay only, no deductible; the emergency-room facility line: the $300 copay, then the deductible and coinsurance on the rest; every other line: the deductible, then coinsurance; copays count toward and stop at the out-of-pocket maximum

visitLimit.rule: a service outside the plan's stored benchmark of essential health benefits; past the limit it is not covered

hsa.telehealth: the HDHP telehealth safe harbor is recorded and not exercised: no telehealth code is in the catalog
